video_title: I Personally Do NOT Believe He's A Max Player." -- Bobby Marks Gives Thoughts On Austin Reaves

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Austin Reaves' contract status and market value as an unrestricted free agent
quotes.excerpt: I think you have to be careful treating him like a restricted free agent.

text_blocks.speaker: Brad Wallace
text_blocks.text: How would you approach the Austin Reaves conversation? We know the max of what he can make is five years, 241 million. He's definitely been playing on a discount for a handful of years. How would you approach their situation?

text_blocks.speaker: Bobby Marks
text_blocks.text: I think you have to be careful treating him like a restricted free agent. He's unrestricted once he declines his player option. I think you have to understand what the market is. Although we can say there are three teams with cap space—Brooklyn, Chicago, and the Lakers—why would he want to go to those two teams? I don't think either team would plop down a four-year, 177 million dollar contract for him.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Bobby Marks' assessment of Austin Reaves as a non-max player
quotes.excerpt: I personally do not believe he is a max player.
quotes.quote: I personally do not believe he is a max player. The system or the market tells you what a player is or is not. If you are offering him, let's say the starting number is 37 and they want 39, don't get cute. Don't get cute.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Austin Reaves' new salary impact on Lakers' free agency flexibility
quotes.excerpt: His new salary has no impact on what the Lakers have to spend in free agency.
quotes.quote: His new salary has no impact on what the Lakers have to spend in free agency this summer because his cap hold is at 21 million dollars. You can basically hold that against the salary cap, fill out whatever you want to do, and then come back and sign him as the last player and then exceed the salary cap.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Proposed contract structure for Austin Reaves to manage cap space
quotes.excerpt: I would probably offer him in year one that 41 million dollar number.
quotes.quote: I would probably offer him in year one that 41 million dollar number and then I would decline it, so then I would go 41, 38, 34. I would do a declining, but for me, to do a five-year 239 is a big number. That is your locked in because it is really not about this year, it is about next year.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: The trade-off of signing Austin Reaves to a max contract
quotes.excerpt: It gets you 21 million more in cap space.
quotes.quote: If you don't sign him, it gets you 21 million more in cap space. So now you have 70. What does 70 get you? Now you need, because right now, for me, the three checklists are shooting, someone to complement Luka, a wing, and of course, we have talked about a center, a lob threat, rim protector.
